sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify approximation, qualification, and tentativeness markers, then pick between close pairs
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите маркеры приблизительности, оговорок и неуверенности и различите близкие пары

items.prompt: Approximation: На конференции было _____ триста участников.
items.promptEnglish: There were approximately three hundred participants at the conference.
items.explanation: Порядка (on the order of, approximately) is a formal numeric approximation marker common in academic and professional writing.

items.promptEnglish: Perhaps we should reschedule the meeting.
items.hint: A soft, tentative 'perhaps' at the start of a suggestion.
items.explanation: Пожалуй (perhaps, I think) signals a tentative, considered opinion. It is softer than a direct recommendation.

items.promptEnglish: This method is, to some extent, universal.
items.hint: A formal qualifier meaning 'to some extent.'
items.explanation: До некоторой степени (to some extent) qualifies the claim: the method is universal, but not entirely or without exceptions.

items.prompt: Conversational hedging: Он _____ уже уехал, но я не уверен.
items.promptEnglish: He sort of already left, but I'm not sure.
items.hint: Informal, conversational 'it seems like / sort of.'
items.explanation: Вроде бы (it seems, sort of, apparently) is an informal hedge expressing uncertainty in everyday speech.

items.prompt: Preference: Это _____ вопрос организации, чем финансов.
items.promptEnglish: This is rather a question of organization than of finances.
items.hint: Used to shift emphasis from one option to another: 'rather X than Y.'
items.explanation: Скорее (rather) redirects the interpretation: this is more about organization than money.

minimalPairs.context: Choosing the right approximation register for a formal report:
options: Стоимость проекта составляет порядка десяти миллионов.
minimalPairs.answer: Стоимость проекта составляет порядка десяти миллионов.
minimalPairs.explanation: Порядка + genitive is a formal, academic approximation. Примерно is neutral and works in any register, but порядка signals professional/academic tone.

translation.english: There were approximately fifty students in the lecture hall.
translation.answer: В аудитории было примерно пятьдесят студентов.
acceptableVariants: Примерно пятьдесят студентов было в аудитории.
В аудитории было около пятидесяти студентов.
translation.hint: Use примерно or около for 'approximately.' Remember case agreement.

translation.english: This theory is, to some extent, correct.
translation.answer: Эта теория до некоторой степени верна.
acceptableVariants: До некоторой степени эта теория верна.
Эта теория в какой-то мере верна.
translation.hint: До некоторой степени or в какой-то мере for 'to some extent.'

translation.english: He seems to have already left. (conversational uncertainty)
translation.hint: Use вроде бы for informal, conversational uncertainty.

translation.english: Perhaps we should reconsider our approach.
translation.answer: Пожалуй, нам стоит пересмотреть наш подход.
translation.hint: Пожалуй for a tentative 'perhaps,' стоит for 'should/it's worth.'
